about: Text rules (solver-knowledge DESIGN.md section (f)): read mod lines the Rust parser leaves unread or partly read. Each row is a form (subject + verb + count + object), not one item's text. Applied only when a caller loads this file (solves do; the answer-key tests never do). mods: '$x' a capture as a number, '$x/100|1' divided by 100 or 1 when absent, '$x:title' a capture with a capital. gate: a capture looked up in killQualifiers (its tags go on every emitted mod); an unknown qualifier reads nothing.

rules.match: ^enem(?:y|ies)(?: you| your \w+)? kill(?:ed)?(?: (?:with|by) (?<q>[^,]+?))? (?:have a (?<c>\d+)% chance to )?explode,? dealing (?:a )?(?<a>\d+)% of their (?:maximum )?life as (?<t>\w+) damage$
